name: TrueSignal honeytoken credential used against a decoy
description: The Hub matched a planted honeytoken (a fabricated credential written into a File Canary lure) in a login against a decoy. The lure was read and its credential is being used. Raised by the Hub only (sensors cannot send it) and never subject to the whitelist or known-scanner lists, so this rule does not filter on them.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: None expected. Only someone who read a lure knows the credential; an administrator testing with it should use a firedrill instead.
note:
## Triage
1. `truesignal.details.planted_node_id` / `planted_sensor_id` name the lure; its `decoy_file_accessed` events show when and how it was read.
2. `truesignal.details.triggering_trigger` / `triggering_event_id` point at the login that used it; `source.ip` is the attacker's host.
3. Run truesignal-honeytoken-authentication (real systems) for the same `truesignal.details.honeytoken_username`.
4. Treat as active intrusion: contain `source.ip` and the host that read the lure.
